g.title: crate These headless interactions combine bindings and owner lifetimes.
crate::announcer Expose reusable live regions for imperative announcements.
crate::axis The two directions a behavior moves along, read from a public Orientation.
crate::calendar A calendar grid behavior attaches month, week, day and month-paging parts.
crate::calendar::data Drawing contracts shared by calendar cells and their registry.
crate::calendar::handle The `CalendarGridApi` handle: grid, rows, paging buttons and day cells.
crate::calendar::machine Decide range choices and external binding changes in one transition.
crate::calendar::policy The selection and the policy a calendar grid is created with.
crate::calendar::state Calendar state shares the shown months, the selection and the day registry.
crate::combobox Expose combobox behavior and keep its transition implementation private.
crate::combobox::handle A combobox filters keyed options by a query and tracks one active option.
crate::combobox::machine Atomic query and highlight transitions for comboboxes.
crate::delayed Expose the delayed behavior and keep its transition rules private.
crate::delayed::api One delayed show and hide machine for tooltips, submenus and hover surfaces.
crate::delayed::machine Compute delayed visibility transitions and own their timer operations.
crate::dialog Dialog attaches modal, alert, drawer and popover surface semantics.
crate::disclosure DisclosureApi attaches an expandable trigger and its optionally delayed content.
crate::drag Pointer drag handles and their pure gesture transitions.
crate::drag::data Shared drag values, options and gesture snapshots.
crate::drag::handle Owner-scoped pointer drag sessions attached to sources as parts.
crate::drag::machine Pure pointer drag lifecycle, threshold, axis, and edit ownership transitions.
crate::drag_settle Shared one-axis drag and detent calculations.
crate::drag_settle::tests Verify constrained drag, snap, and overshoot calculations.
crate::drag_velocity Reexport the canonical pure release velocity estimator.
crate::edit Edit session handles and their pure lifecycle transitions.
crate::edit::handle Edit sessions: the start, commit and cancel of one continuous edit.
crate::edit::machine Pure edit-session transitions shared with draft editing.
crate::focus_return One target and reason policy for returning focus when a surface closes.
crate::follow_end Expose viewport following commands backed by an owner-scoped machine.
crate::follow_end::api Keep a vertical scroll viewport attached to the end of growing content.
crate::follow_end::machine Transition measured viewport changes into following and history scroll commands.
crate::hover_corridor Preserve hover travel through a timed corridor.
crate::hover_corridor::api Preserve a hover-open surface while the mouse travels towards it.
crate::hover_corridor::geometry Test pointer travel against the facing edge of a hover surface.
crate::hover_corridor::machine Compute pointer corridor transitions and progress deadlines.
crate::inline_edit Own an inline rename request and its mounted draft session.
crate::interaction_policy Theme-wide interaction policy and its per-control options.
crate::list One list behavior attaches selection and navigation through parts.
crate::list::data Passive list inputs, policies and observable item state.
crate::list::handle The `ListApi` handle: setup options, reads, selection commands and parts.
crate::list::input ListApi input enters the shared selection and navigation state.
crate::list::machine Keep virtual focus requests until their source loses focus.
crate::list::order Logical list order normalizes keys and chooses enabled destinations.
crate::list::parts ListApi parts bind and unregister exact mounted focus targets.
crate::list::selection Selection transitions preserve caller order and hidden selections.
crate::list::state ListApi state shares one registry, selection writer and focus authority.
crate::list::typeahead Type-to-find navigation for menus and lists.
crate::menu Application menus with nesting and typeahead.
crate::menu::handle The `MenuApi` handle: open state, triggers, content, items and submenus.
crate::menu::level The levels of an open menu: rows, focus, keys and pointer.
crate::menu::machine Pure menu session transitions own levels, focus requests and submenu timers.
crate::menu::order Pure menu lookup and retained-level ordering helpers.
crate::menu::press Track a held menu pointer and activate the eligible row at release.
crate::menu::press::tests Check when drag release can pick a menu item.
crate::menu::press_machine Pure held menu pointer transitions and owner-scoped hold timing.
crate::menu::press_state Store the held pointer, surfaces and row highlights of a menu.
crate::menu::session Menu session operations coordinate opening, focus and closing.
crate::menu::state Store menu entries and shared session state.
crate::menubar A menu bar moves the open menu among a row of menu triggers.
crate::options_cell Setup-only options with reactive values for mounted parts.
crate::palette Expose palette behavior and keep its transition implementation private.
crate::palette::handle A command palette joins a modal dialog and a combobox over commands.
crate::palette::machine Palette visibility transitions reset its combobox atomically.
crate::policy Pure policies supporting owner-aware interaction controllers.
crate::policy::grid Two-dimensional grid moves from keys, independent of a UI runtime.
crate::policy::scalar Validated scalar bounds and optional quantization, independent of a UI runtime.
crate::popup Expose the popup behavior and keep its transition rules private.
crate::popup::api PopupApi adds overlay focus, dismissal and restoration to a disclosure.
crate::popup::machine Compute one popup surface's focus range, dismissal and restoration.
crate::press The pointer presses that several behaviors read the same way.
crate::range_scalar Two thumbs editing the ends of one range without crossing.
crate::reorder Describe a keyed collection item moving to a new position.
crate::roving Share roving membership and requested-focus bindings.
crate::roving::machine Serialize requested, observed and removed-member focus events.
crate::roving::registry Roving focus registry shared by list, table and menu levels.
crate::roving::requested Preserve the caller binding as the authoritative requested key.
crate::scalar Binding-backed scalar operations and semantic control parts.
crate::scalar::data Drawing state shared by scalar controls and edit tracking.
crate::scalar::edit_state Edit session, drag and focus count shared by the thumbs of one scalar.
crate::scalar::focus_machine Cancel shared scalar edits when a thumb blur leaves no thumb focused.
crate::scalar::handle Scalar binding writes, key steps, assistive actions and parts.
crate::scalar::ops The writes of a scalar value: normalize, step and set through the binding.
crate::scalar::range The ranges a scalar accepts, and the write-back when one leaves the value out.
crate::scalar::range_machine Normalize all scalar ends for a range change before ordering binding writes.
crate::scalar::touch Adapt raw touch pointer events and the display clock to scalar transitions.
crate::scalar::touch_data Passive configuration, contact samples and release-coast data.
crate::scalar::touch_machine Decide touch press, slop tracking, release coast and edit effects atomically.
crate::scalar::track Map the pointer along a slider's track to the value of a thumb.
crate::scalar::track_data Passive thumb targets, track geometry, grips and active grabs.
crate::scalar::track_machine Keep track attachment geometry and the current grab in one phase.
crate::sealed Public-in-bounds traits that only this crate can implement.
crate::select Expose select behavior and keep its transition implementation private.
crate::select::handle A select attaches a combo box trigger and its list box to caller nodes.
crate::select::machine Select opening, surface and shared navigation state transitions.
crate::selection Single and multiple selections share one binding input contract.
crate::space_pan Space held on a focused surface, the modifier of a Space-plus-primary pan.
crate::space_pan::handle Attach the Space modifier machine to focused surfaces.
crate::space_pan::machine Represent the Space modifier and disarm on unavailable surfaces.
crate::splitter Unstyled behavior and semantics of a splitter between two panes.
crate::splitter::handle Attach splitter input, edit ownership, and semantics to a handle.
crate::splitter::machine Preserve collapsed sizes and settle splitter drags at normalized stops.
crate::splitter::options Store setup-only splitter options and immutable transition snapshots.
crate::table A table behavior attaches grid, header, row, cell and resize parts.
crate::table::cells Cell-focus rows and cells move a roving tab stop with grid keys.
crate::table::data Passive table inputs, the focus pattern and observable part state.
crate::table::handle Table options, sorting, widths and grid, row and cell parts.
crate::table::model A headless row model: filter, sort and page the caller's rows by column.
crate::table::sort Compute ordered sort transitions while caller bindings remain authoritative.
crate::table::state DataTableApi state shares the row list, sort, widths and the cell registry.
crate::tabs Tabs attach keyed semantics and navigation to caller-owned elements.
crate::text_edit Headless native text editing over the public primitive contracts.
crate::text_edit::draft A text input that edits a draft: Enter commits, Escape and blur end it.
crate::text_edit::handle The `TextEditApi` handle: native editing options and the control part.
crate::text_edit::machine Control mounting and IME composition transitions.
crate::text_edit::policy Pure native editing keys and clipboard normalization.
crate::toaster Queue toast notifications and own their deadlines.
crate::toaster::api Toast notifications with dismissal control.
crate::toaster::column Own the notification queue, visibility limit and independent hold identities.
crate::toaster::data Notification content, queue entries and focus attachments.
crate::toaster::timer Own one toast's focus restoration and independently paused deadline.
crate::toggle Button, check box, switch and toggle button semantics without appearance.
crate::tone The meaning of a status, a notification or a message, as plain data.
crate::tooltip Expose tooltip parts while keeping the App hub transitions private.
crate::tooltip::api Tooltip attaches a delayed hover and focus hint, one shown per App.
crate::tooltip::machine Track tooltip precedence and the named skip-delay interval.
crate::tree TreeApi navigation with expansion and selection.
crate::zoom_pan Shared view transforms and owner-scoped zoom and pan input.
crate::zoom_pan::data Define view transforms, options, and passive gesture snapshots.
crate::zoom_pan::handle Attach zoom and pan machines to the caller's viewport.
crate::zoom_pan::machine Own zoom and pan contacts and the edit attached to each active gesture.
